decision.summary: A sustained U plateau (>8) begins around index 610 and ends with a multi-sample drop near 665–667. N/E exhibit correlated transient offsets during the drop, consistent with a possible temporary offset. However, no clear return to pre-event baseline is observed before index 729; U remains elevated and noisy afterward. Thus, the interval is classified as uncertain due to ambiguous recovery.

intervals.observation: U component rises to >8 from ~610, sustained until ~665; N/E show correlated transient offsets during the multi-sample drop near 665–667. Return to pre-plateau levels is not observed within allowed context (ends at 729), and post-drop U remains elevated (~7.5–10) with high noise—no clear reversion. Status: uncertain.
